sections.title: Valuation Insights
sections.text: Read GAAP margins, average-equity returns, debt including current maturities and cash generation using the explicit definitions below. The annual-filing P/E uses a dated close and an older filed earnings denominator. It is not a current TTM multiple. Peer fiscal calendars, revenue definitions and business models differ. Quarter and annual-release columns are kept separate.

insight.text: Cash remaining after the disclosed capital outflow is a separate constraint on the earnings narrative.
